# Pass Two — Architecture Choice

The Awtsmoos gives light a vessel; shared contracts give scale a stable frame.

## Competing Approaches
A. Bespoke monetization per product — reject: inconsistent and expensive.
B. Injected global iframe — reject: brittle and detached from product context.
C. Shared catalog metadata + commerce shell + product adapters — preferred.
D. Rewrite entire site as one SPA — defer: destructive before contracts demand it.
E. Progressive shared platform layer over current routes — preferred with C.

## Layers To Preserve / Extend
- `apps/wallet`: source-of-truth consumer wallet experience.
- `games/scripts/catalog`: game metadata, marketing and commerce declaration.
- `games/scripts/storefront`: reusable game marketplace interaction/presentation.
- `games/scripts/wallet-rewards`: earned reward transport/claim flow.
- Existing shared styles/tokens/catalog infrastructure discovered next.

## Contract Questions Before Source Changes
1. Exact wallet endpoints and purchase/ownership payloads.
2. Peruta precision and balance semantics.
3. Existing product-credit or entitlement representation.
4. Commerce-plan schema used by game cards.
5. Existing app catalog metadata and shared platform navigation.
6. Current mobile token system and reusable shell components.
